scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.db:local-reset: node server/scripts/reset-local-db.js && cd server && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx prisma db seed
